meta.description: Add WhatsApp Business Cloud API channel via Chat SDK. Official Meta API.

copy.tagline: 用 Chat SDK 接入 WhatsApp 官方消息通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发需要接入 WhatsApp 消息的应用。
copy.tagline_en: Add WhatsApp Business Cloud API channel via Chat SDK
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building a chat app that needs WhatsApp messaging.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会复制 WhatsApp Cloud 适配器到项目、注册通道、安装固定版本依赖，然后运行构建和测试。完成后 NanoClaw 能通过 Meta 官方 API 收发 WhatsApp 消息，但需提前配置好凭据和 webhook。
howto.when: 当用户要求接入 WhatsApp 官方通道，或提到“/setup”、“/manage-channels”等安装流程时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 NanoClaw 接到 WhatsApp 官方 API
say.note: 会执行复制适配器、注册和安装步骤。

say.text: 添加 WhatsApp Cloud 通道并安装依赖
say.note: 会运行构建和测试验证。

say.text: 运行 /manage-channels 把 WhatsApp 通道配给我的代理
say.note: 会把通道绑定到指定代理组。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude copies the WhatsApp Cloud adapter into the project, registers it, installs the pinned dependency, then runs build and tests. NanoClaw can then send/receive WhatsApp messages via Meta's official API, provided credentials and webhook are set up.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to connect the official WhatsApp channel, or mentions "/setup" or "/manage-channels" during setup.

say_en.text: Connect NanoClaw to the official WhatsApp API.
say_en.note: Copies adapter, registers channel, installs dependency.

say_en.text: Add the WhatsApp Cloud channel and install its dependencies.
say_en.note: Runs build and tests to verify.

say_en.text: Run /manage-channels to wire WhatsApp to my agents.
say_en.note: Binds channel to the agent group.
